name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A pre-packaged set of know-how and checklists that helps someone find real security holes in websites and apps, instead of guessing.
buyer: A freelance bug-bounty hunter or independent security researcher who wants to find more valid, payable bugs faster.
business_use_cases: A freelance bug hunter runs it against public bug-bounty programs to find more valid, higher-severity reports per week.
A solo security consultant uses it to deliver a structured pre-launch penetration test report to a small business before they go live.
A boutique security shop uses the curated vulnerability patterns as a training checklist for junior hires.

money_ideas.idea: Bug bounty payouts earned by finding and reporting real vulnerabilities faster
Paid pre-launch security audit for small businesses using the same checklists

steal_this: Run it against a friendly local business's staging site this weekend and sell them a paid pre-launch security report.
